title: A bit Static
body:
Right now, habits feel a bit static. It would be much more motivating if the experience worked more like FarmTown:
Custom Placement: Allow users to decide where to “plant” their habit items, rather than having them appear in fixed spots. This would give a sense of ownership and creativity.
Interactive Habits: Make it so that when you click on a plant (or other habit representation), you can immediately see the details of that habit—its progress, streaks, notes, etc. without needing to navigate through menus. These changes would make the app feel more alive
author: mother of toodler
